title: Hunts FH-031U: Check the finale gate on a preview deployment
detail: FH-031T gated the completion reward and the Event stop on the finale seat (app/(main)/hunts/[slug]/play/finale-actions.ts, migration 20270346086000_hunt_finale_reward_gate.sql). Owed, by a person: apply the migration through the serialized migration gate (docs/DATABASE.md), then on a preview deployment with HUNTS_ENABLED, HUNTS_CLAIMS_ENABLED and HUNTS_REWARDS_ENABLED on for that preview only, finish a Trail whose finale Event is full while holding no seat. Pass when the player sees the full message, the Collect tap answers that the reward comes with a place at the finale, and afterwards the player holds no RSVP, ticket or reward grant. Record the result in docs/ledger/evidence/FH-031U.md. Production switches stay OFF.
